title: Required April accounts-payable source is missing
evidence: The task explicitly lists AP_TB-1.xlsx and says all listed reference files are in /home/model/Desktop. That file is absent from the Desktop, problem assets, and other searched locations after both initialization phases. initialize.py stages only 17 files and has no operation for AP_TB-1.xlsx. The March template contains only March AP detail. Consequently, the April schedule balance of 313,891.43 and the 672.35 reconciliation difference required by two separate [+1] rubric items cannot be established from the provided AP source. This also corroborates the AP-related FileNotFoundError excerpts in Runs 1 and 2.
confirmation: Confirmed: AP_TB-1.xlsx is missing from the task's data folder although the prompt lists it and says all files are on the Desktop. The AP Trade schedule balance and the 672.35 reconciliation difference cannot be derived.

No agent can match the expert on this tab.
